title: Sweet Pea Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Sweat Pea is a 1 BR / 1 BA / 4 Guest cottage in Seaside, FL. Offering up sensational views of the Gulf of Mexico, the ‘Sweet Pea’ penthouse invites guests with a stylish and sophisticated setting, looking down upon the many diverse offerings of Seaside.
description_expanded: Description121 Central Square, Unit E31 KING, 1 SLEEPER SOFAElevated Gulf Views in the Heart of SeasidePerched high above Central Square in Seaside, Florida, Sweet Pea is a stylish penthouse condo offering sensational, panoramic views of the Gulf of Mexico and the vibrant town below. This chic coastal retreat is designed for guests seeking an unforgettable Seaside vacation, where sunrise coffees and sunset cocktails are just as memorable as the sugar-white sands only a short stroll away.Prime Location Above Central SquareLocated on the third and fourth floors of the iconic Dreamland Heights building, Sweet Pea enjoys one of the most sought-after locations in Seaside, FL. Guests are perfectly positioned to experience the energy of Central Square while still enjoying privacy, elevated views, and cooling Gulf breezes. From dining and shopping to live music at the amphitheater, everything Seaside is known for is right outside your door.Bright, Modern Living SpacesInside, the penthouse features crisp white interiors and clean architectural lines that enhance the home’s airy, coastal feel. The main living level boasts vaulted ceilings over the open living and dining area, creating a sense of spaciousness and light. This level includes a comfortable sofa sleeper accommodating two guests, a flat-screen TV, a full kitchen with stainless steel accents, and a full bathroom with a shower.Outdoor Living with Stunning ViewsStep outside to the private balcony on the main level, where you can relax, unwind, and soak in Seaside’s near year-round sunshine. Upstairs, the penthouse opens to a serene king bedroom complete with another flat-screen TV, offering a peaceful retreat after a day at the beach.Private Rooftop Terrace ExperienceThe highlight of Sweet Pea is the private rooftop terrace, an exceptional outdoor space overlooking Central Square, the dunes, and the shimmering Gulf waters beyond. With comfortable seating and unmatched views, this rooftop is ideal for entertaining, relaxing, or simply taking in the beauty of Seaside from above.A One-of-a-Kind Seaside PenthouseWith its contemporary design, elevated outdoor spaces, and unbeatable location, Sweet Pea offers a truly unique Seaside vacation experience. Please note that this penthouse includes multiple staircases between levels and may not be suitable for all guests. For those seeking style, scenery, and proximity to the best of Seaside, Sweet Pea delivers an unforgettable coastal escape.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES448 square feet and located in Seaside’s Central SquareSeaside Beach Access at Coleman Pavilion2-minute, 482-foot walk to beach accessOverlooks the town and Gulf with incredible panoramic viewsPrivate rooftop terrace for elevated outdoor livingPeacock Alley Linens – fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 Pickleball courts (court fees apply), plus a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedOne parking pass included; shared permit parking located behind the Holl Building based on availability, with additional permit parking along Quincy CircleGolf carts are considered cars; golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedNo laundry in unit
